harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 both at runtime and persistently across reboot, and verified via a full node restart with changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: usb-storage not currently loaded (lsmod count 0)
Created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with 'blacklist usb-storage' and 'install usb-storage /bin/true' to prevent both alias-based auto-load and explicit modprobe load
Verified modprobe usb-storage succeeds (exit 0) but does not actually load the module
Rebuilt initramfs via dracut -f to bake the modprobe config into early boot image, confirmed presence via lsinitrd
Issued 'shutdown -r now' in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until SSH/exec was available again
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual reboot occurred
Post-reboot: verified usb-storage still not loaded and modprobe still blocked by the install redirect

evidence.requirement: Baseline: usb-storage module not loaded before change
evidence.summary: lsmod grep returned 0 matches for usb_storage prior to any modification; modinfo confirmed module exists on disk
Created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with blacklist + install /bin/true directives; modprobe usb-storage then exits 0 but lsmod count remains 0, proving the module cannot be loaded
Rebuilt initramfs with dracut -f; lsinitrd confirms /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with both directives is embedded in the boot image used at next boot
Captured boot_id bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5 and uptime -s (2026-08-26 10:33:30) as the pre-restart boot identity baseline
Issued 'sudo shutdown -r now' backgrounded with nohup; command returned exit 0 with PID before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Immediately after reboot issued, exec timed out (node down); on next poll exec succeeded with new boot_id 3ad85187-982b-4653-8397-d9813ff8183c and new uptime -s (2026-09-04 23:27:45), proving an actual restart occurred, not just a service bounce
After reboot, lsmod shows usb_storage count 0, modprobe usb-storage still exits 0 without loading it (via install /bin/true), and the blacklist config file is intact on the running filesystem

attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 both at runtime and persistently across reboot, and verified via a full node restart with changed boot identity.
